content.title: National Burrito Day 2026: Deals and freebies from Chipotle, Qdoba and more
content.text: Published April 2, 2026 7:29am CDT Burrito fans, listen up! National Burrito Day returns on Thursday, April 2, bringing with it a nationwide wave of burrito deals, freebies and flavorful perks from fan-favorite restaurants. From Chipotle to Qdoba, here are the fast-casual chains that will be serving up savings in 2026. Chipotle deals on National Burrito Day More than $2 million in Chipotle prizes will be available to unlock through the Burrito Vault game for Chipotle rewards members on National Burrito Day. Each hour during regular gameplay, the first player to unlock the vault wins free burritos for a year. Then, 3,600 "buy-one-get-one" (BOGO) entrees will be awarded. After those are claimed, 2,000 double protein rewards will be awarded. National Burrito Day will bring deals and freebies from major chains like Chipotle and Qdoba on April 2. (Credit: Getty Images) During Double Protein Power Hour gameplay, the first two players to unlock the vault win free double protein burritos for a year. Then, 7,200 double protein BOGO entrees will be awarded. After those are claimed, 4,000 double protein rewards are awarded. Learn more about Chipotle’s Burrito Vault game here. Free Qdoba burrito on ‘National Burrito Day’ Check your Qdoba Rewards Wallet on April 2. The company said it will automatically add a Free Entrée with purchase of an entrée and drink reward on National Burrito Day. Rewards Gold Status Members will receive extra time to redeem the offer – valid until April 5. El Pollo Loco offers BOGO special On Thursday only, burrito lovers can also buy one à la carte burrito at El Pollo Loco and get one free. The deal is available to El Pollo Loco rewards members only. Baja Fresh offers $5 burritos on National Burrito Day To celebrate National Burrito Day, Baja Fresh will be offering $5 Baja Burritos with chicken. Plus, Club Baja rewards members who make any purchase on National Burrito Day will receive a $5 off $20 offer loaded directly to their Club Baja rewards account. Moe's Southwest Grill BOGO on National Burrito Day Moe's Southwest Grill is offering a buy-one-get-one-free burrito or bowl at participating locations for National Burrito Day. The offer is valid for Moe rewards members at select participating locations from 3/31 - 4/2/26. Plan ahead What you can do: If you’re planning to make the most of National Burrito Day, here are a few quick tips: Join the rewards programs early. Most deals require app-based membership to redeem offers.Check location participation. Not all franchises may offer the deals, so double-check your local store online.Plan ahead. With some deals limited by time or inventory, early participation boosts your chance of scoring freebies. What is National Burrito Day? The backstory: National Burrito Day is an annual celebration held on the first Thursday of April that honors the popular Mexican-inspired dish. The term "burrito" is believed to have come from street vendors in Mexico who sold food from baskets carried by donkeys – or "burros." Over time, these tightly wrapped, portable meals took on the nickname "burritos," or "little donkeys," according to several reports. Today, the burrito has become a beloved staple across the U.S., inspiring this yearly celebration with deals from coast to coast. The Source: The information for this story was provided by deals on company websites. This story was reported from Los Angeles. Previous FOX Local reporting contributed. ConsumerFood and DrinkU.S.
